prompt.text: The cafe network has no password. Mail is already trying to sync. A window offers to join.

choices.label: Join and read the mail
choices.debrief: That network belongs to anyone sitting near you.
choices.report: Company mail synced on an open cafe network.
choices.voice_line: You read company mail on a network with no password.

fallout.text: A session from that network reads the same mailbox again, after you have left the cafe.

choices.label: Use the company hotspot and wait to sync
choices.debrief: The hotspot is the path the company can see. The cafe network is not.
choices.report: Mail waited for the company connection.
choices.voice_line: You used the company hotspot. The cafe network stayed off.

choices.label: Join just to send one reply
choices.debrief: One reply is still the mailbox, on their network.
choices.report: One message went out on the open network.
choices.voice_line: You joined the open network for a single reply.

fallout.text: The reply is intact. The mailbox token from that session is not.

draft_note: Right choice is the company path, not a shorter visit to the open network.
